# Wösten et al. (2001), Staring Series hydraulic parameters for Dutch soils.

## Source

Wösten, J. H. M., Veerman, G. J., de Groot, W. J. M., & Stolte, J. (2001). Waterretentie- en doorlatendheidskarakteristieken van boven- en ondergronden in Nederland: de Staringreeks; vernieuwde uitgave 2001. Alterra-rapport 153. Wageningen: Alterra.

## Scope

**Territory:** Netherlands

**Dataset:** 832 measured soil-horizon hydraulic characteristics used to define 18 topsoil and 18 subsoil classes and to fit continuous regressions for mineral soils.

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_class_parameters`

Return the six published hydraulic parameters for a Staring Series class.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Residual and saturated water content, saturated hydraulic conductivity, and alpha, l, and n for a source-defined Staring Series class.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — van Genuchten model with m = 1 - 1 / n; $k(h)$ — Mualem-van Genuchten hydraulic-conductivity model

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `soil_class` | `Wosten2001SoilClass` | — | — | Source class identifier used to select a Table 3 row. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | cm³/cm³ | 0 <= value <= 1 | Residual volumetric water content. |
| `theta_s` | cm³/cm³ | 0 < value <= 1 | Saturated volumetric water content. |
| `saturated_conductivity` | cm/day | value >= 0 | Saturated hydraulic conductivity. |
| `alpha` | 1/cm | value > 0 | Inverse pressure-head scale of the van Genuchten model. |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | dimensionless | — | Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. |
| `n` | dimensionless | value > 1 | van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. |

!!! note

    Class identifiers select published rows; this function does not classify soil from texture ranges.

!!! warning

    The source cautions that class means may not apply outside the measured ranges within each class.

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_hydraulic`

Evaluate water content and conductivity from Staring Series parameters.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Volumetric water content and unsaturated hydraulic conductivity at a nonnegative pressure-head magnitude.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — van Genuchten model with m = 1 - 1 / n; $k(h)$ — Mualem-van Genuchten hydraulic-conductivity model

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | `number` | cm³/cm³ | 0 <= value < theta_s | Residual volumetric water content. |
| `theta_s` | `number` | cm³/cm³ | theta_r < value <= 1 | Saturated volumetric water content. |
| `saturated_conductivity` | `number` | cm/day | value >= 0 | Saturated hydraulic conductivity. |
| `alpha` | `number` | 1/cm | value > 0 | van Genuchten inverse pressure-head scale. |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | `number` | dimensionless | — | Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. |
| `n` | `number` | dimensionless | value > 1 | van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. |
| `pressure_head_magnitude` | `number` | cm | value >= 0 | Nonnegative magnitude of pressure head; callers must convert any signed-negative convention explicitly before calling. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water_content` | cm³/cm³ | theta_r <= value <= theta_s | Volumetric water content at the supplied pressure-head magnitude. |
| `conductivity` | cm/day | value >= 0 | Hydraulic conductivity at the supplied pressure-head magnitude. |

!!! note

    Pressure head is accepted as a nonnegative magnitude to make the sign convention explicit.

!!! warning

    Parameters must belong to one internally consistent van Genuchten-Mualem parameter set.

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_sand_topsoil_table5`

Evaluate the printed Table 5 regressions for mineral sandy topsoils.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Bulk density, saturated water content, saturated conductivity, and the alpha, l, and n parameters from the printed sandy-topsoil regressions.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Table 5 parameter regressions for the van Genuchten model; $k(h)$ — Table 5 parameter regressions for the Mualem-van Genuchten model

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `silt` | `number` | % | value > 0 | Mass percentage of particles smaller than 50 micrometers. |
| `organic_matter` | `number` | % | value > 0 | Soil organic-matter mass percentage. |
| `median_sand_size` | `number` | µm | value > 0 | Median particle size of the sand fraction. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bulk_density` | g/cm³ | value > 0 | Dry bulk density predicted through the printed reciprocal-density regression. |
| `theta_s` | cm³/cm³ | — | Saturated volumetric water content predicted by the continuous regression. |
| `saturated_conductivity` | cm/day | value > 0 | Back-transformed saturated hydraulic conductivity. |
| `alpha` | 1/cm | value > 0 | Back-transformed van Genuchten inverse pressure-head scale. |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | dimensionless | — | Back-transformed Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. |
| `n` | dimensionless | value > 1 | Back-transformed van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. |

!!! note

    This function fixes the source-defined BOVENGROND indicator to 1.

!!! note

    Positive inputs are required by the reciprocal and natural-log terms.

!!! warning

    The reciprocal-density expression must be positive before inversion.

!!! warning

    These are the printed rounded Table 5 equations; they do not claim numerical parity with the unavailable Staringreeks 1.0 program.

!!! warning

    The report does not publish the legacy program's applicability-warning thresholds.
